notes.title: Major bug fixes and Single player made easier
notes.notes:
[p]We heard you! some people wanted the single player to be more accessible and we just did that now the early game in the single player level is much more balanced and have some safe nets to catch you if you slip.
Major bugs fixed in the game and lobby system. now you can easily join your friends with an invite code.
Networking code has been optimized resulting in a very smooth gameplay.
[/p]

notes.title: New Challengers Entered the Arena
notes.notes:
New Challengers Entered the Arena:

As a token of our appreciation for all our Korean players, we are excited to introduce the graceful and beautiful Korean character Yerin (예린) to the roster! Alongside her, new challengers from other timelines have emerged, all vying for the title of the next champion in the Climb and Cry arenas. Now, our game boasts a roster of 16 challengers, each ready to face off in 12 unique maps.

notes.title: SINGLEPLAYER IS HERE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225202/2fa00aa71b8e0d411311033a5062df7b17fc6ab8.png[/img]
We’re thrilled to announce a major update that’s guaranteed to bring even more fun and excitement to the game! With the introduction of Single Player Mode, players can now enjoy a challenging solo adventure whenever they want—perfect for those times when your friends are offline or you’re craving some personal triumph. Get ready to test your skills and determination in this epic new mode designed for climbers who want to stand out and dominate.

Here’s what’s new:

Single Player Mode Added: Tackle a massive, thrilling, and brutally challenging map designed to test your climbing skills to their limits.
Be the King of Climbers: Prove yourself by conquering every obstacle and reaching the top to claim the ultimate title.
Exclusive Cosmetic Reward: Complete the final zone to unlock a one-of-a-kind cosmetic inspired by the zone's theme. Wear it proudly in-game to show everyone who's boss.
Biome Variety: This single-player map features a stunning mix of beloved biomes, each packed with fresh, creative challenges to keep you on your toes.

notes.title: Voice chat is here!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to bring you Proximity-Based Voice Chat
Now, your voice becomes a weapon—or a distraction. Hear and talk to nearby players as you climb, shoot, and strategize your way to victory. Whether you’re taunting opponents, forming temporary alliances, or laughing at the chaos, this feature adds a whole new layer of fun and intensity to every match.

The climb just got louder and a lot more personal. Jump in and experience the madness!

notes.title: Single player Release on Nov30!
notes.notes:
Get ready for an exciting new chapter in the world of our rage-inducing platformer! The highly anticipated single-player map, The Void Realm, is finally here. This massive new challenge takes players on an epic climb through a collection of fan-favorite biomes, each with a fun and unexpected twist.

Prepare to navigate fresh obstacles, master tricky maneuvers, and test your climbing skills like never before. While there are safe points scattered throughout to help you catch your breath, don’t get too comfortable—there’s always a chance of a misstep sending you back further than you’d like. Only the most determined will conquer the climb.

Are you ready to take on The Void Realm? Prove your skills and see how far you can go!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN IS HERE BOYS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225202/8fefcde386a174ea5cf1dbb018e66f59edcefeb4.png[/img]
Get ready to experience Halloween like never before with our special event update! Dive into uniquely decorated maps, crafted exclusively for this Halloween season, where every detail is designed to immerse you in a spooky, festive atmosphere. These themed maps are only available for a limited time, so gather your friends, explore the haunted scenes, and take on challenges to earn the ultimate prize: the golden pumpkin head trophy! Compete, explore, and celebrate Halloween in style. Don’t miss out on this exclusive chance to add a piece of rare seasonal flair to your achievements!
